name: sample/supervisor — a route node dispatches to the right specialist
description: The v1 'route' primitive (docs/ai-routing-nodes.md): the supervisor pattern. The node's OUTGOING DATA EDGES are its choice set — config.options keys must equal the downstream node ids EXACTLY (validated at save). The 'llm' decider makes one structured single-choice call (choice + mandatory reason; the decision costs 1 budget unit); if the choice is invalid the declared 'fallback' edge is taken — never a silent retry. Untaken branches are SKIPPED with the pinned 'not routed' reason, so the choice is visible in the event stream.

options.web-dig: Gather up-to-date context: search the web and read the local knowledge base, then report findings.
options.code-run: Do the work hands-on: write, run, and test the code the goal asks for, then report the result.
